title: Enroll the Android Companion for PR push
description: Use a selected development device connected to the validation gateway. The OS notification permission must already be granted. This enables PR push on that device; disable it after the delivery proof.

open.cmd: adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d 'farmslot-development:///pr-automation' net.siteed.farmslot.development
open.intent: Open the real PR automation route on the selected Android device.

ready.intent: The notification tab is reachable from PR automation.

notifications.intent: Open recipient-scoped attention and device registration.

show-toggle.intent: Reach the push enrollment control below the team filter.

enable.intent: Explicitly enroll this device for real PR push delivery.

registered.intent: Expo token acquisition and gateway registration have completed.

screenshot.intent: The screenshot records the enabled notification status returned by the gateway.

verify.intent: A separate authenticated gateway client sees the Android registration without receiving its token.
